items.reason: The investigational element is dose-intensified hypofractionated MR-Linac RT; temozolomide is the concurrent backbone ("concurrent Temozolomide (75 mg/m2) will administered daily") and is coded soc_backbone by both coders, not an established-therapy experiment, so no drug at all is under investigation. 'established_therapy_only' fits trials whose drug question is an established GBM therapy.

Glioblastoma is named in the title ("Glioblastoma Hypofractionated Treatment"), which counts under C7; eligibility "high grade glioma (histologic grade 3 or 4, IDH wildtype)" includes IDH-wildtype grade 4 (CNS5 glioblastoma) plus grade 3.

note: Excluded at S6 either way; the disagreement only changes the Figure 1 exclusion label. A shortened 3-week concurrent TMZ course could be argued as a schedule change (rule 6 -> established_therapy_only), but the record does not frame TMZ as the question.
